$comment: Named or verified campus features that must never silently disappear. A build whose output lacks one of these ids in the listed files fails validation and does not replace public/data. To add a landmark: append {id, in, why} with the stable feature id (osm:way/…, osm:relation/…, cur:…) of a feature that exists in the current build, the files that must contain it (buildings, places, boundary) and what makes it a landmark (its OSM name tag, a survey, …). Never add a guessed id. Removing one on purpose means editing this file in the same change. Schema: scripts/lib/landmarks.ts.

landmarks.why: Campus boundary relation (OSM name 'Lovely Professional University'); the boundary every membership rule depends on.
Named campus building: OSM name 'Lovely Institute Of Management'.
Named campus building: OSM name 'Lovely Institute of Technology'.
Named campus building: OSM name 'Lovely Institute of Pharmacy'.
